record.question: Which organisation has been designated as a terrorist organisation by the US for the Pahalgam attack?
record.explanation: Answer C: The Resistance Front. The U.S. State Department designated The Resistance Front as a Foreign Terrorist Organization in connection with the Pahalgam attack. Reference: https://www.state.gov/designation-of-the-resistance-front-as-a-foreign-terrorist-organization/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
